ul.li: 1: Customer completes in-store purchase (optional email receipt)
1a: XML data sent to Data Warehouse
2: Outbound data processing sends to CrowdTwist

2a-2d: CrowdTwist sends multiple data types to Braze:
User transactions (CDI Sync)
Purchase activity
Point balance updates
Redemption data
X-Store Digital Receipt captures optional email requests
CrowdTwist processes loyalty data from warehouse
Multiple event and attribute types sent to Braze
REST API (users/track) used for all CrowdTwist → Braze updates

text.tspan: CDI Sync Event Data - User Transactions
